verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own site claims you can "Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents," which is a thin first-party signal of AI agent capability. Its tool catalog is exposed to agents via MCP, but that is a separate, client-facing feature. Custom Node.js code steps that could call an LLM are only a developer building block and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented AI/LLM steps placed inside a workflow, model selection, documented tool use by in-workflow agent steps, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents in seconds.
